name: Add New Feature
description: Workflow for adding a new feature or section to the portfolio

feature_name.description: Name of the feature to add (e.g., 'Blog Section', 'Testimonials')

feature_description.description: Detailed description of what the feature should do

steps.prompt:
Investigate the current project structure for the Haunted Portfolio at /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/Kiroween/haunted-portfolio.

Feature to add: {{feature_name}}
Description: {{feature_description}}

Tasks:
1. Review the existing component structure in components/sections/
2. Check lib/data.tsx for data structure patterns
3. Review the design patterns in existing sections
4. Identify where new files need to be created
5. Plan the implementation approach

Provide a clear plan for implementing this feature that matches the existing design system and code patterns.

Based on the investigation ({{investigate.output}}), implement the new feature: {{feature_name}}

Requirements:
1. Follow existing component patterns (see .kiro/steering/component-patterns.md)
2. Match the design system (dark theme, lavender/crimson accents)
3. Use Framer Motion for animations
4. Make it responsive (mobile-first)
5. Add the feature to app/page.tsx
6. Update navigation if needed
7. Add sample data to lib/data.tsx if required

Ensure the code is clean, well-typed, and follows existing conventions.

Test the implementation:

1. Run 'npm run build' to check for TypeScript errors
2. Verify the component renders correctly
3. Check responsive behavior (mobile, tablet, desktop)
4. Ensure animations work smoothly
5. Verify it matches the design system

Fix any issues found and report the final status.
